# Question: generator-shortcuts

The strongest plausible rival is **exact shape matching**: find the unique blue component, then recolor only non-blue components whose translation-normalized cell set is identical to the blue shape. This fits all three canonical demonstrations (3/3), because every canonical positive is an exact copy even though the intended rule is equality of the broader feature triple `(area, enclosed-hole count, reflection-symmetry class)`.

Here is an exact v4-generated input (`seed=390000`, `sample_index=0`, `difficulty=easy`), written as digit rows:

```text
0000000000000000
2222001111002222
2022001100002020
0000001000000000
0000000000000000
0000000000000000
0000004440005550
0000004040005050
0000004400005050
0000000000000000
0000000000000000
```

The blue component has triple `(7,0,0)`. The color-2 component at upper left has the same triple but a different normalized shape. Therefore the intended rule recolors that component to 8:

```text
0000000000000000
8888001111002222
8088001100002020
0000001000000000
0000000000000000
0000000000000000
0000004440005550
0000004040005050
0000004400005050
0000000000000000
0000000000000000
```

The exact-shape rival leaves the input unchanged, so the two rules disagree visibly. I checked the intended output with the supported canonical Racket command:

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 39fd645f21c6 --input ../checks/shortcut-counterexample/input.json --out ../checks/shortcut-counterexample/racket.json
```

The receipt records executed and catalog rule hash `36a57f0bfc36`, `rule_hash_matches_catalog=true`, and a valid output. The Racket output equals the independently implemented feature-triple mirror and differs from the exact-shape rival. Exact files are under `checks/shortcut-counterexample/`.

The repaired generator deliberately emits such cases. Every positive match uses a shape different from the seed, and every scene also includes one-coordinate area, holes, and symmetry decoys. The source-bound census found no declared ambiguity in 300 lessons (100 per band, 1,200 unique pair inputs), and the independent task-local probe checked all 1,200 cyclic query rotations with zero failures while finding a counterexample for every declared rival. Evidence: `checks/lesson-census-final.json` and `checks/shortcut-probe-final.json`.
